input.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in General Provisions
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance covenant, as the Agreement currently requires no coverage from Licensor even though it operates the Licensed Technology and transmits our market data and trade orders. Our playbook position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; we can discuss E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Licensor processes Licensee data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; together with workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide certificates of insurance to Licensee on request.
